excerpt: UPL Bs 4 sitao is a bush sitao variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1990. It takes about 45 days from sowing to the first harvest, with 11.09 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 11.09 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about UPL Bs 4 sitao
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

UPL Bs 4 sitao takes about 45 days from sowing to the first harvest. That is about the average of the 5 bush sitao varieties with a day count, 46.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 11.09 t/ha beats the average of its group, 10.16. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit sitao fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its pods grew about 31.3 cm long. A hundred seeds weigh about 14 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed coat is maroon with black stripes.
Where and when to plant UPL Bs 4 sitao

Pole sitao climbs a trellis and bears for weeks, while bush sitao needs no trellis and comes in at once. Pick long, dark green pods that snap cleanly, and a variety rated against the bean fly and rust if you can. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 45 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 11.09 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of UPL Bs 4?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
